result.topic_en: This is the engraved plate (Tab. VII) for Euler's paper on fluid friction: Figs. 1–5 show vessels with attached pipes (vertical, contracted, horizontal, inclined, and one feeding a fountain jet) used in the analysis of outflow with friction.
